ask: Pay a $1.99 redelivery fee on a link

message.body: USPS: your package is on hold. Pay a $1.99 redelivery fee today: https://usps-hold.test/pay

source.attribution: Prudence demo cases (Scam Shield), CC BY 4.0

verdict.headline: This is not USPS.
reasons: USPS never asks for a fee by text message.
The link is not on usps.com.
